title: Microsoft to invest up to $5B in Anthropic

sources.quote: As part of the partnership, NVIDIA and Microsoft are committing to invest up to $10 billion and up to $5 billion respectively in Anthropic.
Amazon, Google, and Microsoft, through their respective affiliates, have made significant equity investments in our company.

explain: Microsoft committed up to $5 billion to Anthropic in November 2025, as Anthropic agreed to buy $30 billion of computing on Microsoft's Azure cloud. Anthropic's IPO filing confirms Microsoft is now a shareholder but does not give the amount paid.
